sources.title: MIDIBack: Harmony-Aware Singing Pitch Correction via Joint Vocal-Accompaniment Symbolic Modeling
sources.limited_conclusion: Accompaniment context improves recovery of synthetic global outshift in symbolic note space, but no end-to-end waveform correction or listening preference was evaluated.
limitations: rounded transcription pitch is pseudo-ground truth rather than a verified score
split grouping by song, singer, artist, or source dataset is not documented
audio is transcribed at 22.05 kHz mono and evaluation is symbolic

sources.title: A Multi-Resolution Spectrogram Approach for Estimating the Physical Parameters of a Plate Reverb
sources.limited_conclusion: A phase channel modestly reduces coordinate ambiguity in matched synthetic low-mode plate inversion; this does not establish real-plate robustness or full-band reverb quality.
limitations: 1470 Hz low-mode regime after factor-30 downsampling
local and official evaluation protocols have different denominators

sources.title: The 1st DAFx Challenge: Physical and Modal Parameter Estimation for Plate Reverberation
sources.limited_conclusion: The matched synthetic benchmark is useful for controlled inversion but cannot distinguish dense interpolation from a general inverse solver and is not real-world perceptual validation.
limitations: same generator and parameter ranges available to participants
no physical plate in the official test

findings: NPZ displacement is the scientific input and normalized WAV is for listening
target ground truth is withheld while a training-data generator is provided
no root LICENSE file was found at the inspected revision
paper licensing does not automatically license repository code or data

knowledge_cards.claim: Accompaniment context strongly improves recovery of synthetic global outshift in MIDIBack's symbolic note space.
MIDIBack's pseudo-target is rounded source transcription, not a verified score or artistic target.
A random 80/10/10 split is not evidence of song-, artist-, singer-, or dataset-disjoint evaluation.
Harmony context trades ambiguity reduction against clean-note preservation in the reported ablation.
Symbolic metrics after mono transcription do not evaluate waveform identity, artifacts, stereo, peaks, or preference.
The 1470 Hz plate setup targets isolated modes and cannot support full-band reverb conclusions.
A phase channel modestly reduces synthetic output-location ambiguity under matched conditions.
The 200-, 5000-, and 16-IR results are separate protocols and must retain their denominators.
Official rank eight bounds the plate paper to a useful within-method phase ablation rather than a broad state-of-the-art claim.
Same-generator/same-range benchmark success does not establish physical-plate or OOD identification.
Peak-normalized WAV invalidates absolute-amplitude physical parameters such as surface density and modal gains.
Paper licensing and repository/data licensing are separate; absent artifact licensing blocks reuse.

candidate_rules.applies_when: a vocal note is ambiguous against accompaniment
candidate_rules.change: use harmonic context only as a target-note hypothesis
candidate_rules.number_provenance: no correction range is proposed by the source

candidate_rules.cancel: non-tonal, deliberately dissonant, or misleading accompaniment

candidate_rules.verify: corruption rate and blind unchanged-note review
candidate_rules.cancel: clean-note edits rise without repeatable preference

candidate_rules.applies_when: a symbolic pitch model proposes corrections
candidate_rules.change: keep target prediction separate from the waveform correction engine
candidate_rules.suggested_range: bounded by the existing conventional correction baseline
candidate_rules.number_provenance: engineering control; no waveform settings are supplied by the paper
candidate_rules.cancel: artifacts or identity loss outweigh pitch benefit

candidate_rules.change: retain absolute-amplitude scientific IR and forbid peak normalization
require noisy, boundary-shifted, parameter-OOD, and preferably measured holdouts
require explicit code/data licenses, file manifest, hashes, and amplitude semantics
candidate_rules.cancel: any required artifact has ambiguous rights or provenance

experiments.title: Accompaniment-guided target notes in a fixed correction engine
experiments.baseline: vocal-only target-note predictor feeding one fixed bounded conventional pitch-correction engine
experiments.variant: same predictor and engine with accompaniment tokens available
experiments.single_factor: accompaniment context available to target-note predictor
experiments.material: rights-cleared multitracks with independent human note annotations
experiments.loudness_matching: preserve raw safety renders and make separate integrated-loudness-matched blind copies
experiments.success: repeatable gain on ambiguous notes without higher clean-note corruption or protected-quality loss
experiments.cancel: split leakage, target leakage, more clean-note edits, audible artifacts, or non-repeatable preference

experiments.title: Pseudo-target versus expert target
experiments.single_factor: rounded transcription target versus independent expert target
experiments.loudness_matching: not applicable until a fixed audio correction engine is added
experiments.cancel: expert annotations are not independent of evaluated transcription

experiments.cancel: only matched synthetic evaluation is available

video_sources.title: Ultimate Bass Mixing on 7 Different Songs
Ultimate GUITAR MIXING On 7 Different Songs

priorities: MIDIBack split, pseudo-ground-truth, clean-note corruption, and code/demo audit
plate paper 5000/200/16-IR protocol reconciliation and real/OOD evidence search
GeoAtt HRTF code and artifact search
existing SpanSynth, DiffusionRIR, BSRNN, and SRF-SVB null tests
permitted transcript retrieval for 38 queued videos
per-file rights-cleared rock multitracks with raw tracks, stems, and final mix

notes: MIDIBack is distinct from the guide-conditioned SRF-SVB/NSVB family
the plate paper is one submission to the official challenge and not independent confirmation

handoff: Treat accompaniment-aware pitch prediction as a hypothesis generator, require clean-note preservation and an independent target, keep the correction engine fixed in A/B tests, and preserve absolute amplitude and evaluation denominators in plate inversion.
